title: A Silver Bullet or a Compromise for Full Attention? A Comprehensive Study of Gist Token-based Context Compression

layout.note: Two columns of framed units: at left a blue input frame above a purple panel (a), at right one orange frame split by a dash-dot line into (b) above and (c). The two question pills sit in the gap in the middle, with coloured, labelled arrows running down to (a) and out to (b) and (c).

lesson: Turn a design space into a figure by chaining question pills whose coloured branch arrows lead to colour-matched sibling schematics, and reuse one token-grid drawing for every variant, changing only the special-token placement and the highlighted lines.
